nodes.long_description:
# Become part of an elite special forces unit in Tactical Assault VR!

• Habie147 - ‘Tactical Assault Is One Of The Best Hardcore Shooters I’ve Played’

• Gamertag VR - ‘The Best Tactical VR FPS On Quest’

• Controlled Pairs - ‘The Best CQB Game I've Ever Played’

Tactical Assault VR is an intense tactical shooter where you use real-world CQB (Close Quarters Battles) tactics to stack up, breach doors and eliminate threats. Play solo or join an online co-op special forces unit in missions around the world.

# Features
**PvE Missions: Solo or Online Multiplayer Co-Op with Up to 6 Players**
{1487526115258066}

**PvP: Competitive Online Multiplayer**
{1082589306850803}

**9 Non-Linear Asymmetrical Missions, 3 Wave Shooter Experiences, Room Randomizer & Sandbox Mode**

Plan your assault. The choice is yours.
{448475627682065}

**Game Mode Variety**

Bomb Defusal, Hostage Rescue, Enemy Surrendering, High-Value Target (HVT) Eliminations, Mini Games, Killhouse, Hardcore Mode.
{1946208202559962}

**60+ Detailed Weapons and Counting**

Customize your loadout with tactical gear including vests, helmets, weapons, scopes, sights, grips and breaching equipment.
{1007758587705278}

nodes.long_description:
Become part of an elite special forces unit and use real-world CQB (Close Quarters Battles) tactics to clear rooms, breach doors, and defeat the enemy threat.

FEATURES:

• Utilize an arsenal of weapons, scopes, sight attachments, explosives and equipment.

• Take note of simulated wind and target distance with the wind meter and spotter scope. Calculate physics-based bullet drop and time-to-hit to improve your accuracy.

• Use stealth to sneak up behind enemies with a silent knife kill. Or go head-to-head against enemies that will take cover and attempt to flank your position.

• Randomized Enemy positions and doors, making each play-through an unknown challenge.

• Non-linear maps give players an endless variety in how they choose to infiltrate and complete missions. Enter buildings through doors, climb ladders to reach rooftops, or climb through windows. The choice is yours.

Tactical Assault VR is currently an Early Access release and is updated regularly.

Tactical Assault VR v0.9.24
• Fixed Thermals not working in PvP and OD missions
• Fixed flashlights not notifying enemies
• Fixed cfour not completing objective in breaking whisper/hammer fire
• Fixed Canto Carrier missing pouches on network avatars
• Fixed lean to prone speed glitch
• Refinements to enemy ai vision
• Updated PvP team selection: client side blocking from joining a full team
• Updated clear team selection on left room to fix ghost teams when joining a new room
• Changed: Weapon Calibration is no longer available in PvP. Weapon Calibration is only available in Missions or Sandbox modes.
• Refinements to quality settings logic
• Optimized Doors (mitigated performance spikes when walking near doors)

Puddle Updates:
• Added aks74 GP rifle with grenade launcher
• Added vog25 grenades as utility items for aks74 GP
• (PCVR) Added separate custom audio folder for M72

Tactical Assault VR v0.9.23
• Added magazine count sync when handing off a magazine to another player
• Enemy AI network optimizations
• Updated enemy targeting
• Avatar now sets to Restricted Outfits room setting when creating/joining a room
• Network Optimizations to all grabbable objects
• Network Optimizations to all weapons
• Updated Sbomber to check if target is in sight before rush detonation
• Synced random skin tones across all players. Still randomized.
• Optimizations to sights/scopes
• Improvements to scene loading
• Changed: If host leaves, all players get sent back to the lobby due to network desync with enemies
• Refinements to PvP team select to prevent uneven teams in a full room
• Updated Deadshot borders with a full border wrap around of the entire map to prevent map exits

• Fixed character selection with private and public rooms
• Fixed wobbly weapon on respawn
• Fixed breaching charges and other utilities taking you to A Whole New World
• Fixed PvP to prevent more than 5 players per team
• Fixed Hidden Forest broken enemy ai navigation (unable to pass through doors)
• Fixed hinges not getting destroyed with breach charge
• Fixed enemies in Flattened Veil getting stuck in tunnel doors
• Fixed beanbag shotgun flashlight
• Fixed Enemy Ai Headshots not registering

Puddle Updates:
• Added AK74M rifle
• Added CQBR rifle
• Added M16A4 rifle
• Changed M16A2 to full auto (M16A3)
• Added PM Classic pistol
• Added new dynamic sights menu, shows available sights and correct previews
• Added 6 new dovetail rail sights (OKP7, PK-A, EKP-1S, 1P63, 2.8x 1P78 and 4x 1P29)
• Added dovetail rail and sights to AKS74U and RPK74
• Added more sights to SVD and VSS

• Fixed USP40 magazines not working with ammo box
• Fixed UMP45 fire selector animation
• Fixed G36C foregrip positions
• Fixed weapon sight zoom toggle hanging after respawn
• Fixed incorrect ban time display when ban is over 24h long
• Fixed M320 GLS range finder not working with terrain

• Removed LMG base movement speed penalty, added movement speed penalty when LMG is raised or fired
• Removed LMG suppressors
